name: dakrauth__django-swingtime
root_api: django.conf.settings.USE_TZ default, observed through DateTimeField values returned by a QuerySet
behavioral_change: Django v_old 4.0 to v_new 5.2.4 (v_old is a resolved value). Django 5.0 flips the default of the USE_TZ setting in django.conf.global_settings from False to True, so datetime values retrieved through QuerySets for DateTimeField become timezone-aware by default; the root cause is a single-line default-value change.
downstream_effect: Existing tests of the downstream project fail because DateTimeField values read back through the ORM now follow the timezone-aware default; the error does not name the settings file that has to be edited.
reference_fix: The reference fix adds an explicit USE_TZ = False to the downstream settings file.

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
